## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the repository work record (for example `vault/delivery/R-001-...md`) and any external issue. Use `Closes #123` only when that issue's outcome is complete.

## Validation

Describe relevant tests and manual checks. For application changes, run `mix precommit` and `mix assets.build`. Include screenshots when the UI changes.

## Knowledge and outcomes

Update the owning work record. Promote reusable findings into the appropriate atomic note and record significant choices as ADRs or DRs. Link related notes and topic maps; preserve unresolved questions and the status of proposals.

## Remaining considerations

Note material limitations, migration or compatibility concerns, and data-quality or privacy implications. Keep essential rationale in the repository rather than only in PR discussion.
